scope: Adapters puros TagDuel para três efeitos contínuos de dano disparados por eventos: Dark Room of Nightmare (dano de efeito recebido pelo time adversário, excluindo a própria carta), Coffin Seller (monstros do time adversário enviados ao Cemitério compartilhado) e Skull Invitation (cada carta enviada ao Cemitério causa 300 ao seu proprietário físico por carta). Quatro caminhos novos; sem resolver, catálogo, certificações, inventário ou dados persistentes.

cards.name: Dark Room of Nightmare
cards.officialEffect: Each time your opponent takes damage from a card effect, except 'Dark Room of Nightmare', inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Coffin Seller
cards.officialEffect: Each time a monster(s) is sent to your opponent's GY: Inflict 300 damage to your opponent.

cards.name: Skull Invitation
cards.officialEffect: Each time a card(s) is sent to the Graveyard, inflict 300 damage to its owner for each card sent.

plannedTests: Dark Room: effect damage to opponent triggers 300 per active copy
Dark Room: battle damage, cost, other damage, unresolved or negated event do not trigger
Dark Room: own team damage does not trigger its own Room; opposing controller routes shared LP correctly
Dark Room: source Dark Room is excluded to prevent recursion
Coffin Seller: one or more opponent-owned monsters sent to shared GY trigger 300 once per active copy and event
Coffin Seller: own-team monsters and non-monster cards do not trigger
Coffin Seller: owner team derives from physical UID across seat rotation
Skull Invitation: each physical card sent to GY causes 300 to its owner team per active copy
Skull Invitation: mixed-owner batch splits damage by physical owner and scales by card count
All cards: face-down/negated sources excluded; duplicate event receipts idempotent
All cards: stale LP snapshots, duplicate/malformed UIDs and uncommitted movement fail closed
All adapters: no mutation of hands, decks, 3+3 zones, separate Field Zone, Extra Deck or inventory
